fields.summary: Rules added in the wizard always get the action allow
fields.description:
When a rule is added with the wizard and the action deny is chosen, the published policy shows the rule with the action allow.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Open Rules and click *Add rule*
# Enter a name and choose the action {{deny}}
# Click *Next*, then *Save rule*
# In the top bar click *Save*, then *Publish*

h3. Expected Behavior
The published policy has the new rule with the action deny.

h3. Actual Behavior
The rule has the action allow.

comments.body: Rules edited later keep their action.

fields.description:
Searching the rule list misses rules whose names use different capitalization.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Have rules named {{alpha-web}}, {{alpha-mail}} and {{Alpha-backup}}
# On the Rules page, search for {{ALPHA}}

h3. Expected Behavior
All three rules are listed.

h3. Actual Behavior
No rules are listed.

The add wizard saves a rule even when a rule with the same name already exists.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Have a rule named {{web-access}}
# Click *Add rule*, enter the name {{web-access}}, click *Next* and *Save rule*

h3. Expected Behavior
The wizard shows the error "A rule named 'web-access' already exists" and no rule is added.

h3. Actual Behavior
A second rule with the same name is added.

fields.summary: A deleted rule comes back after publishing
fields.description:
Deleting a rule from the list and publishing shows a success message, but the published policy still contains the rule.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Have three rules
# Select one rule, click *Delete selected* and confirm
# In the top bar click *Save*, then *Publish*

h3. Expected Behavior
The published policy has only the other two rules.

h3. Actual Behavior
All three rules are still published.

Changing a profile's level and then clicking *Reset* in the top bar does not discard the change.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Open a profile with level {{low}}
# Set the level to {{high}} and click *Save profile*
# In the top bar click *Reset*

h3. Expected Behavior
The profile is back to level low.

h3. Actual Behavior
The profile keeps level high.

fields.summary: The rule list loses the action filter on the next page
fields.description:
With an action filter applied, going to the next page of the rule list shows rules of all actions again.

h3. Steps to Reproduce
# Have more than five rules with the action {{allow}}
# Filter the rule list by {{allow}}
# Click *Next*

h3. Expected Behavior
Page 2 still shows only allow rules and the filter stays selected.

h3. Actual Behavior
The filter is cleared and rules of every action are listed.
